name: Mama Thandi's Kitchen
shortDescription: Home-style Xhosa cooking and weekend braai plates.
description: Mama Thandi's Kitchen has been feeding Gugulethu since 2014, from umngqusho and tripe on weekdays to full braai plates every Saturday. Everything is cooked to order in small batches, so nothing sits under a heat lamp.

name: Khaya Cuts Barbershop
shortDescription: Fades, line-ups and hot towel shaves, no appointment shaming.
description: Four chairs, four barbers, one waiting bench that's always full for a reason. Khaya Cuts specialises in fades and beard sculpting, and keeps Saturday mornings open for walk-ins only.

name: Reliable Flow Plumbing
shortDescription: 24-hour burst pipe and geyser call-outs across the Cape Flats.
description: A two-van operation run by qualified plumber Faizel Adams, covering burst pipes, blocked drains and geyser replacements. Emergency call-outs are answered around the clock; quotes are free within a 15km radius.

name: Bright Spark Electrical
shortDescription: COC certificates, DB board upgrades and load-shedding-ready wiring.
description: Registered with the Department of Employment and Labour, Bright Spark handles certificate of compliance inspections, distribution board upgrades and backup power wiring for inverter and solar installs.

name: Ubuntu Learning Hub
shortDescription: Maths and science tutoring for grades 8 to 12, in English and isiZulu.
description: A small after-school centre run by two former public-school teachers, offering group and one-on-one tutoring in maths, physical science and English first additional language. Report-card progress checks are shared with parents each term.

name: Moments by Lerato
shortDescription: Matric dance, birthday and family portrait photography.
description: Lerato Moeketsi shoots on location across Johannesburg, specialising in matric dance portraits and family shoots at golden hour. Packages include an edited digital gallery within seven days.

name: Sparkle Home Cleaning Co-op
shortDescription: A worker-owned cleaning co-op serving homes and small offices.
description: Sparkle is a cooperative of eight cleaners who set their own rates and rotate clients fairly among themselves. They offer weekly, bi-weekly and once-off deep cleans, and bring their own eco-friendly supplies on request.

name: Nomvula Designs
shortDescription: Made-to-measure traditional wear and everyday alterations.
description: Nomvula Dlamini trained as a tailor for fifteen years before opening her own studio. She makes traditional wear for weddings and umembeso ceremonies, and handles everyday alterations while you wait on weekday mornings.

name: Coastal Breeze Café
shortDescription: Fresh linefish, curry bunny chow and strong filter coffee.
description: A family-run café two blocks from the beachfront, known for its curry bunny chow and daily catch specials chalked up on the board each morning. Outdoor seating gets busy after 12pm.

name: Glow Beauty Bar
shortDescription: Gel nails, lash lifts and bridal make-up trials.
description: A bright, three-chair studio offering gel and acrylic nails, lash lifts and bridal make-up trials by appointment. First-time clients get a complimentary consultation to plan out bridal party bookings.

name: Steady Hand Plumbing & Maintenance
shortDescription: General maintenance, geyser servicing and rental property call-outs.
description: Steady Hand handles the unglamorous but essential work: dripping taps, geyser servicing and the odd emergency for landlords managing several rental units. Monthly maintenance contracts are available for property managers.

name: Little Stars Tutoring
shortDescription: Foundation phase reading and numeracy support, grades R to 3.
description: Little Stars focuses on the early years, helping grade R to 3 learners catch up on reading and numeracy in small groups of no more than four children. Sessions run straight after school pick-up.

name: Frame & Focus Studio
shortDescription: Product photography and small-business branding shoots.
description: Frame & Focus helps small businesses build a proper image library for their online listings and social pages, with half-day and full-day product photography packages shot in a home studio in Centurion.

name: Fresh Start Cleaning Services
shortDescription: Move-in, move-out and post-construction deep cleans.
description: Fresh Start specialises in the cleans nobody wants to do themselves: post-construction dust removal, move-out deep cleans for tenants chasing their deposit back, and once-off spring cleans.
